description: This PHP class handles Stripe subscription and donation requests within the Omnipay payment processing framework. It manages creating checkout sessions, retrieving customer and product data from Stripe, generating redirect URLs, and completing purchases by updating subscriptions and processing donations.

classes.name: SubscriptionRequest
classes.description: A class managing Stripe subscription and donation requests, including session creation, customer retrieval, and purchase completion within the Omnipay framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SubscriptionRequest with provided data and sets up the Stripe client using a secret key.

methods.name: sendData
methods.description: Creates a Stripe checkout session for subscription based on user and invest data, and returns a SubscriptionResponse.

methods.name: completePurchase
methods.description: Completes the purchase process after checkout, retrieves and updates Stripe subscription data, and handles donation logic.

methods.name: getRedirectUrl
methods.description: Constructs a URL for redirection based on URL parts and current server protocol and host.

methods.name: getInvestReward
methods.description: Retrieves the reward ID associated with an investment or returns a default string if no reward.

methods.name: getStripeCustomer
methods.description: Searches for an existing Stripe customer by email, or creates a new customer if none exists.

methods.name: getStripeProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a Stripe product by ID, or creates a new one if it doesn't exist, with description based on the investment and project.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Generates metadata for an investment including donation amount, project, reward, and user IDs.

methods.name: getProductId
methods.description: Determines the product ID for an investment, with or without a project.

methods.name: getProductWithProjectId
methods.description: Constructs a product ID string based on project ID, reward, and user ID.

methods.name: getProductWithoutProjectId
methods.description: Constructs a product ID string based on investment ID and user ID.

methods.name: getStripeCurrency
methods.description: Determines the currency for the Stripe transaction based on project or user preferences.
